coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket; glioblastoma eligible via arm label 'Part 2A' and inclusion criteria. M3T01 (anti-FasL mAb) is the only investigational agent; pembrolizumab is described as standard of care (soc_backbone), although in Part 1B it is the combination partner under dose escalation. Temozolomide (Part 2A Stupp chemoradiation) and FOLFOX components (Part 2B) coded soc_backbone; FOLFOX split into oxaliplatin, folinic acid (leucovorin) and fluorouracil with regimen_id FOLFOX. agent_name_registered for TMZ and FOLFOX components given with parent intervention name. Regimen differs by arm: Part 1A is M3T01 monotherapy; Part 1B/2 are combinations; coded combination overall. MGMT unmethylated, IDH-wildtype and non-H3K27M are cohort requirements for Part 2A (IDH and H3K27M via cohort-specific exclusion), none candidate-matched. Target engagement coded yes based on pharmacodynamic data for RP2D and on-treatment biopsies (GBM patients do not undergo protocol biopsy); PK is serum only.
